page: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-1g is an accelerator-optimized server instance designed for high-performance computing and machine learning workloads. The hardware configuration features 26 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with an x86_64 architecture, running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. This CPU setup includes 13 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by a 105 MB L3 cache. For acceleration, the instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU containing 80 GB of VRAM. System memory consists of 234 GB of RAM, providing 9.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via an 804 GB NVMe SSD.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong single-core performance, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 2072.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 33.6 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 27427.61 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 14893.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 2213.07 GB/sec, which drops to 159.18 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. For language model execution, the server achieves top-tier performance on small models, generating 348.05 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model, but performance decreases to 23.8 tokens per second for a medium 7B model and 2.49 tokens per second for a large 70B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the a3-highgpu-1g represents a high-density resource allocation where the cost is heavily driven by the premium NVIDIA H100 GPU and large memory capacity. The instance is highly suited for deep learning training, small-to-medium LLM inference, high-performance computing, and GPU-accelerated data science tasks. However, the poor performance on 70B parameter models indicates a tradeoff where larger models require multi-GPU configurations rather than this single-GPU instance.

It features 26 dedicated Intel Xeon 8481C vCPUs operating at 2.7 GHz, 234 GB of RAM, and an 804 GB NVMe SSD. The core of its performance is a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU with 80 GB of VRAM. Benchmarks show strong single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2072.0, and top-tier text generation speeds of 348.05 tokens per second for small 135M parameter LLMs. However, performance drops significantly to 2.49 tokens per second for large 70B models, highlighting a clear scaling tradeoff.
